name: Mary Magdalene
summary: A woman out of whom Jesus cast seven devils, who followed Him and helped provide for Him. She watched His crucifixion, and she was the first to whom He appeared after He rose.

key_moments.title: Following Jesus
key_moments.description: Jesus went through cities and villages preaching, with the twelve and some women He had healed. Among them was Mary Magdalene, out of whom seven devils had gone.

key_moments.title: Watching at the Cross
key_moments.description: Mary Magdalene and other women who had followed Jesus from Galilee watched the crucifixion from a distance. Then she saw where His body was laid.

key_moments.title: Finds the Stone Taken Away
key_moments.description: Early on the week's first day, while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene came to the tomb and saw the stone had been moved away. She ran to tell Peter and the other disciple.

key_moments.title: Called by Name
key_moments.description: Mary stood weeping outside the tomb. Jesus said her name, she knew Him and called Him Rabboni, meaning Master, and then she went and told the disciples about seeing the Lord and what He said.
